json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter & Validator
json-formatter.description: Format, validate, beautify or minify JSON instantly — right in your browser.
json-formatter.seoTitle: JSON Formatter & Validator — free, local, no upload
json-formatter.seo: Paste any JSON and get it formatted with your choice of indentation, minified for production, or validated with precise error positions. The parsing uses your browser's own JSON engine, so even sensitive payloads stay on your device.

base64-converter.name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
base64-converter.description: Convert text to Base64 and back, with full Unicode support — all in your browser.
base64-converter.seoTitle: Base64 Encoder & Decoder — Unicode-safe, runs locally
base64-converter.seo: Encode plain text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to readable text. Unlike naive converters, this tool handles the full Unicode range correctly — Chinese characters, emoji and accented letters all survive the round trip. Conversion happens entirely in your browser.

ui.invalid: That doesn't look like valid Base64.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate strong random passwords with your browser's crypto engine — nothing is sent anywhere.
password-generator.seo: Passwords are generated with crypto.getRandomValues(), the same cryptographically secure random source browsers use for TLS keys. Choose length and character sets, watch the entropy estimate update in real time, and copy with one click. The password never leaves this page.

ui.needOne: Select at least one character set.
